tasks.short: Give guests local information and directions.

steps.what: Clarify where guests want to go and explain local information or directions.

tasks.design: Keep brief local-information conversations with the waiter. Check whether existing visitor guidance in {DOCS} needs correction, but do not introduce an automated travel answer or claim a new administrative baseline.
tasks.previous_blocker: This is usually a short situational conversation rather than repeated data processing.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change is needed for the retained conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Temporary closures, accessibility needs and uncertain local knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt directions to a guest who is unfamiliar with the area and admit uncertainty.

ambition.what: Give landmark-based directions to guests who find street names difficult.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in weekly responsibilities or decision rights.

reach.task: Explain nearby transport access to arriving guests.
reach.learn: Local landmarks and when to refer guests to current official information.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a short local-information conversation can remain human with no credible software labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is a brief conversation about a destination; live transport research or booking is not silently added. The single step retains the same actor, means and output.

Guests provide destination and mobility needs verbally; staff provide known landmarks. Unknown or time-sensitive facts are explicitly referred to current official information rather than guessed. No new structured data or extraction interface is proposed.

Check existing native visitor guidance before considering code. Zero upkeep is justified because no new system, published guide or transferred work is introduced; the ambition is an optional service improvement, not a free labor-saving claim.
unknowns: Frequency and complexity of guest direction requests.
research_questions: Would clearer landmark explanations help guests more than a new digital tool?

incremental.description: No new automation or upkeep is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 upkeep=0 net=0. Both routine directions and accessibility-sensitive requests retain the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Describe wines and recommend choices to customers.

steps.what: Ask customers about wine preferences, food choices and spending comfort.
Check the wine list for available bottles, prices and producer descriptions.
Describe and recommend wines, explaining tradeoffs without pressuring the customer.

tasks.design: Test a native wine-list view in the {OTHER} restaurant point-of-sale system that links current stock and prices to approved descriptions in {DOCS}. Keep taste judgement and the recommendation conversation with the waiter; missing descriptions trigger a specialist question rather than invented tasting notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: The printed list and actual cellar stock can disagree.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured item views can link approved descriptions to current available bottles.
tasks.still_hard: Customer taste is subjective and bottle substitutions require care.
tasks.human_edge: Read hesitation, explain flavours plainly and recommend within the guests budget.

ambition.what: Help guests unfamiliar with wine compare two options using plain flavour descriptions.

tasks.altitude: Less list checking; wine recommendation and pricing authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Serving measures, available styles and specialist escalation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an approved wine catalogue linked to stock can shorten factual lookup without replacing taste-based conversation.

assumptions: Boundary covers advice only, excluding opening, pouring and payment. Preference discussion and recommendation time retain their full shares.

Beverage lead supplies wine_id, vintage, style, approved_description, bottle_price and glass_price; stock team supplies available_quantity and timestamp. Missing or vintage-mismatched facts retain manual bottle checks and specialist referral.
Test native item views before custom code. No generated tasting claim, inferred allergen guarantee or customer profile is introduced.
unknowns: Current list accuracy and time spent checking bottle availability.
research_questions: Does the linked list reduce unavailable recommendations without flattening personal advice?

already_counted.description: Read the available wine facts and check vintage relevance.

incremental.description: Maintain approved wine descriptions and vintages.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=94 gross=6 net=5 after 1 upkeep. Low: waiter already knows current stock; high: separate list and cellar checks. Preference and recommendation conversations are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep personal hospitality while making modest factual lookups easier.
role.ambitious_version: A waiter who makes local information and wine choices approachable for unfamiliar guests.
